segments.name: K2
segments.prompt: A chibi bunny-eared girl mage with long silver-lavender hair in a thick braid, blue eyes, a navy hood with tall white rabbit ears and a crescent and snowflake ornament, a white fur-collared navy coat with a long ice-blue snowflake cape, white stockings and boots, holding a tall silver staff topped with a crescent moon and an ice-blue snowflake in her right hand, already recoiling from a hard hit at the first frame, dazed with eyes shut, immediately begins recovering: no second jolt. She opens her eyes, steadies herself with a slight knee flex and returns smoothly to her guard stance of the last frame; hair and cape swing with one diminishing overshoot. Feet adjust minimally between the supplied endpoint stances, staying grounded without sliding or hopping; no turning or scale change. Arms, shoulders and torso drive the action; hair, cloth and cape follow with natural overlapping motion. Preserve her identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid staff, always drawn whole and clearly visible. No added effects, aura, glow, dust or particles.
